limits: A completed diagnostic is not successful recorder completion or a qualified sampler stack.
Final no-live-group observations establish cleanup at their observation time; they do not retrospectively timestamp every descendant exit at the sampler deadline.
Parent-observed stream clocks are observation bounds, not exact internal tool event times. Native callback deltas use only the helper continuous-clock domain.
A Darwin notification callback does not authenticate its sender or establish a trace epoch.
Trace archive identity and bounded packaging do not establish semantic validity, recording completeness, exported tables, or application-route coverage.
No retained sampler report/stack identifies task acquisition, early symbol discovery, capture, report processing, or authorization as the cause.
The D24 notification-only helper differs from D21; these results do not establish D21 causality.

retainedComparison.clockCaveat: Parent monotonic progress and helper-native callback clocks are reported separately. Within the parent clock, Intel recorder stdout follows both sampler operations by at least4.498479844s. The helper-native callback is late in its15s window (~14.109752s), but this audit does not assert an exact parent/native epoch transform, callback sender, trace epoch, or IPC order.
interpretation: All four D24 sampler streams end after one exact initial banner; no completion/processing-symbols marker, report-written marker, report-file progress or final report is retained.

D21 has the same external one-of-three milestone shape. D22 has all three milestones plus a report under the same logical sample arguments, but a different controlled target; its original calibration-incomplete result is preserved.
The installed -mayDie documentation describes immediately collecting symbol locations. Missing later processing-symbols text cannot exclude eager symbol work or locate an internal wait.
S<s primary ps snapshots establish a live sleeping process/session leader at the before snapshots, not a stack or wait subsystem. No primary-after identity or stack was obtained.
Successful finite diagnostic/cleanup bookkeeping is separate from recording success: Intel recorder ended with exit-11 after SIGINT then SIGTERM; this ordering does not establish why it faulted.
A notification callback is a receipt on the registered name/token. It does not identify its sender or prove a trace capture epoch.
